column1: # Catalog of purpose-built, intentionally-vulnerable TRAINING targets.
# These images are published by their projects specifically for security
# education. Each row is a target you can spin up on the lab network.
#   id            short name you type:  ./lab target up <id>
#   category      web | network | upload | api | ad
#   type          image  (single container)  |  compose (dir under targets/<id>)
#   ref           image reference, or compose dir name
#   ports         host:container web port to publish, or "-" for none

column6: Damn Vulnerable Web App - classic web pentest trainer
